promotionRule: a requirement is verified only when the gate passed and a repository acceptance test named with its id passed; a decision is verified only when its evidence exists and every requirement it serves is so verified; invalid evidence is rejected; everything else is provisional

verified.statement: Suspensions are held in Library.Suspensions (Map<MemberId, SuspensionReason>) rather than on Member; standing is derived by Library.standingOf as the closed type Standing = Active | Suspended of SuspensionReason; SuspensionReason has a private constructor refusing blank text.
The JSON store gains an optional 'suspensions' array; stores without it load with all members active; format tag stays lending/1 because the change is additive.

The suspension check runs immediately after the member lookup in borrow and hold (before copy/book lookup and DEC-002/DEC-005 rules); in renew, where the member is known only from the loan, it runs right after the loan is found and before the DEC-004 conditions; return is unchanged.
No renew CLI command or use case was added (none exists); the renewal refusal is enforced in Tier 2 Loans.renew and tested there.

Tier 2 Loans.overdue computes days overdue with Fines.daysLate (the function returnCopy uses), keeps loans with days > 0 (so a loan due today is not overdue) and sorts by days descending then copy id (ordinal).
Tier 3 Views.overdue projects the count and the '1 day'/'N days' wording so the CLI does no arithmetic or comparison on lending values; 'overdue' with extra words prints its usage line.

renew <copy> calls the existing Tier 2 Loans.renew unchanged: unknown copy, not on loan, suspended member (U1-D3), then DEC-004's conditions in order; a loan due today can be renewed; the 'of 2' is Policy.renewLimit projected by Views.ofRenew.
LoanView gains Renewed: int option (None when never renewed); the CLI appends ' (renewed N)' only for renewed loans; loan order is unchanged.

LEND-L04-R3 is not implemented because Ordo reports ORDO.CONTRACT.UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT (CONFLICT-L04-STAFF-BORROWING); staff are treated like every other member (including the LEND-L04-R2 refusal) until the owners resolve it.
What a member owes is the sum of all assessed fines via the existing Fines.outstanding (no exemption, no reduction; no payments or waivers exist yet).

Fines.ensureMayBorrow runs in Loans.borrow right after the suspension check and before the copy lookup and DEC-002/DEC-005 rules; threshold Policy.maxOwedToBorrow = 5.00, owing exactly 5.00 is allowed; holds and returns are unaffected.
Fine gains Paid: decimal (0..Amount); Amount never changes; Fines.outstanding (owes and the LEND-L04-R2 borrow check) sums Amount - Paid.
Library.Fines is already oldest first (Loans.returnCopy appends), so allocation and the fines listing use list order; the team-lead handoff saying newest first is false.
Payments are also kept as a ledger (Library.Payments: member, amount, day); JSON adds optional 'payments' and per-fine 'paid' (missing = 0) with format tag unchanged.

provisional.statement: Unknown member is reported before already/not-suspended; a blank quoted reason prints 'error: a suspension needs a reason'; a missing reason prints the usage line.
Suspending a member leaves their existing loans and holds untouched.
overdue is read-only and lists every overdue loan regardless of the member's standing (suspended members included).

Amount syntax is digits with optional '.' and 1-2 digits, > 0 (PaymentAmount.parse, private constructor); '1.', '.5', signs, exponents, commas are invalid; checks run unknown member, invalid amount, then more than owed ('owes only 0.00' when nothing is owed).
